description: Test current iPhone and Android sizes, Safari and Chrome, portrait/landscape, forms, chat, videos, downloads, and checkout.
primaryOwnerTitle: Imani Heartbeat — Chief Technology & Risk Officer

method.safariCoverage: iOS Safari and iOS Chrome user-agent strings plus Chrome mobile viewport/touch emulation. WebKit/Safari.app was not available on this Linux host.
method.visualPass: Chrome window resized to 390x850 (iPhone 16 portrait) against the same production host.

layout.notes: All public pages returned HTTP 200. No horizontal overflow (scrollWidth - innerWidth <= 2) on any tested device or orientation. Homepage hero, language toggle, and BEGIN YOUR JOURNEY CTA remain in view at iPhone 16 and Pixel 9 portrait.

forms.ageGate: Present on registration, support, checkout offer, and architect routes. Yes + Confirm unlocks the underlying form. Radios are 16x16 CSS pixels; labels wrap them.
forms.contact: Not a form by design. Mailbox + Support CTA only. /contact returned 200 with no <form>.
forms.iosZoomRisk: Text inputs use .bh-form-input text-base (16px). Age-gate radios measured 14px font; they are not text fields and do not trigger iOS input zoom.

publicLumina.opening: PASS — MEET LUMINA trigger opens marketing content. No overflow.

codeReview.openingUses100vh: min-h-[calc(100vh-6rem)] — iOS Safari chrome can shrink usable height versus 100dvh

publicJourney.note: Public Journey marketing page has no <video> elements.

codeReview.chapterDownloadButtons: Chapters 3–7 expose download controls with min-h-11 patterns in app-shell CSS.

offer.note: Stripe configuration was not modified. Hosted Stripe Checkout was not opened.

matrix.portrait: PASS — iPhone SE, iPhone 16, iPhone 16 Pro Max, Pixel 9, Galaxy S24
matrix.landscape: PASS — iPhone 16 and Pixel 9 on /, /register, /lumina, /checkout, /checkout/blueprint (offer redirects to login; login form fills landscape width without overflow). Register first/last name become two columns at md (landscape 852/915 CSS px).

findingsForRow187.issue: Manifesto, Contact, Support, Privacy Policy, and brand/language links measure 15–25px tall (below 44x44 WCAG 2.2 target). Skip-to-main is 36px tall.
Native radio/checkbox controls are 16x16. Age-gate radios are wrapped in labels (larger hit area). Consent checkboxes on registration are 16x16.

Lumina opening uses min-h-[calc(100vh-6rem)]. Cinematic entrance already uses 100dvh + safe-area-inset. iOS Safari dynamic toolbar may compress the opening. viewport meta is width=device-width, initial-scale=1 without viewport-fit=cover.
devices: iphone family — not confirmed on native Safari

findingsForRow187.issue: Runtime of Lumina composer, founder <video>, and Architect download buttons was not reached on production because those routes require a signed-in Architect. A repo e2e account was attempted and did not authenticate. Do not treat this as a layout failure.

validation.typecheck: not_required — status-only file, no production TypeScript change
validation.tests: not_required — package.json has no npm test script; this deliverable is device testing, not a product change
validation.build: not_run — change cannot affect production runtime
